name: OP_ZoneEntry
description: Server sends zone entry data when client enters a zone. Triggers full zone load sequence. Confirmed 0x42 in Ghidra test fixtures (textquest-common/src/ghidra_db.rs line 737).

name: OP_ClientUpdate
description: Client sends position/state acknowledgment to server. Confirmed 0x80 in Ghidra test fixtures (textquest-common/src/ghidra_db.rs line 763). Also mapped as 0x1643 in Dec 2024 binary research via UdpConnection::SendMessage hook.

name: OP_ClientUpdate_Alt
description: Per-frame position update (raw position + velocity, fires ~15ms when moving). Confirmed via MQ2reachit hook on UdpConnection::SendMessage in Dec 2024 binary. May be same logical opcode as 0x80 on a different patch. Requires reconciliation. See docs/research/C1-movement-agreement-packet.md.
